tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun sa skya pa'i zab chos nā ro mkha' spyod kyi 'khrid 'chad tshul sa chen thugs thig bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra wā ra hi/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i zab chos rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i khrid 'chad pa'i skabs su nyer mkho 'ga' zhig brjod na/ slob ma bde mchog lū nag gam/ kyai rdor gyi dbang bskur thob pa la/ yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu gnyis song dus dge bar mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs byed/ de'i yig cha'ang tshar chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i rgyun khyer 'di dang / sgrub mchod kyi yig cha gnyis na gnad khyad par can yod pas 'di thog nas nges par byed thub na legs shing / dbang bshad sogs cha lag rnams ni lugs 'di la tshad mar gyur pa gzhan nas kha bskang chog bla ma gong ma gzhan gyis mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi yi ge rnams na tshar chen lta bu'i gnad de yod med sna tshogs 'dug ngag dbang chos grags kyi dang byin rlabs kyi yi ge zhig yod snyam pas khong yang mkhas grub gzhan las gnad 'gag 'dril ba zhig yin/ gang ltar dbang byin rlabs thob pa'i slob ma rnams la 'khrid 'chad pa'i tshe/ gnas dben par stegs khebs ldan 'bru bkram pa la byung na mkha' spyod ma dang / mkha' 'gro spyi gtor zlum po'i bar du dur khrod bdag po'i gtor ma/ bsdu na zlum gtor gcig gang ltar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod bcas bshams la/ nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ spos kyis bdug slob dpon gyi mdun du 'thor nas ḍā ma ru rdor dril nang mchod rnams bsham/ las kyi rdo rje'i drung maṇ+ḍal 'bru dri bzang gi chu rnams bshams la/ slob ma tshogs gong slob dpon gyis mkha' spyod ma'i bsgom bzlas dang / 'khrid gang 'chad pa de bsgoms la bkra shis kyi bar bya/ slob ma rnams kyis phyag dang yon phul/ rigs dang / yon tan rgan pa dang bslab pa sogs kyis gral rim la 'khod grub pa dang / slob dpon gyis thal mo sbyar la/

bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / dpon slob kun gyis 'ur 'don byas la he ru ka'i yig brgya nyer gcig brjod/ thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma bdag ni sogs bshags sdom gyi tshig gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin brjod la/ slob dpon nam gzhan gang rung gis bskul la/ brgyud 'debs lam rim gnad bskul rnams tshar chen gyis mdzad pa bzhin bya/ byung na brgyud 'debs la tshar chen yab sras kyi gsung gdangs yod pa bzhin gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang gi mchog gi lam srol byung tshul phag mo'i chos skor gyi rnam gzhag dang bcas pa rgyas par btang nas/ bla brgyud kyi rnam thar tshugs tsam byas la/ de lta bu'i grub pa'i slob dpon chen po de nyid nas bzung bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du brgyud pa zam ma chad pa las 'ongs pa'i rje btsun rdo rje zhes sogs gong bzhin la 'khrid yig nang gi rgyas pa de min pa'i mdor bsdus shig gtong / des mtshon pa'i 'og ma thams cad la shes par bya'o/ /yang chos 'byung mi gtong na khrid yig nang bzhin yin/ khrid dmigs thun rjes mkhyen brtse'i khrid yig sgo lcags gong sa lnga pa'i mthong grol lde mig gis phye bas mi shes pa ci yang med/ drin chen brag rtsa ba chen po ni mthong grol lde mig tu gsungs pa'i bsdus don tshigs bcad ma de yang nyin re bzhin gsungs pas zhu mi rnams la sa bcad nges pa'i khyad chen po yong bar 'dug bla ma gong ma'i phyag len la ni med pas gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang chen po ni bsdus don tshigs bcad ma de mi gsung / 'di gnyis gang byed rang 'dam ka yin/ mkhyen brtse'i khrid yig dang / mthong grol lde mig gnyis rwa sprad nas las dang po pa rnams kyis rtogs sla ba'i phyir brjod na/ nub dang por mkhyen brtse'i khrid yig gi 'dir dus gsum nas brgya stong ngam gsum nges par brjod de bar/

slar yang thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir da dung lan gcig bskyar na/ 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam gyi rim pa nyams su len pa la gang zag rab 'bring gsum mam/ shin tu tha ma skye ba brgyud nas zhes pa nas/ gsum nges par brjod do bar/ slar yang thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir da dung lan gcig bskyar na zhes sogs bshad ma thag pa bzhin lan gcig bskyar la/ gsum nges par brjod dgos pas sngon nas nyams len byed bzhin pa yin na/ tshad med kyi rnal 'byor sogs shar gyi nyams su blangs la smon lam bkra shis kyi bar bya/ da nas bzung nyams len byed pa yin na/ skyabs sems kyi rjes su de lta bu las byung ba'i dge ba rnams gzhan don du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig snyam pas/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /sogs bsngo ba dang smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas btab nas/ thun las ldang ba dang / thun mtshams thams cad du yang sgo gsum dge ba'i bya bas dus 'da' dgos pas do nub kyi thugs dam dmigs pa'i rim pa de tsam la mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la slob mas phyag phul nas rang gnas su phyin/ de nas bzung khrid ma grol bar la thun bzhi chags med byed/ 'di pa'i lugs la mthong grol lde mig tu gsungs pa ltar byin rlabs thob nas rgyun khyer dang / oṃ gsum ma'i dam bca' chag med du bzla dgos pas/ gong du rnam gzhag gnyis bshad pa de ni spyir btang tsam mo/ ༈ /nub gnyis pa la 'dir dus gsum zhes pa nas/ gsum brjod do bar kha sang bzhin tshar gcig bskyar la/ da do nub kyi nyams len gyi rim pa la'ang bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang / gcad don dmigs par bsgril nas nyams su len pa gnyis yod pa las/ dang po la bzhi pa tshad med kyi rnal 'byor ni zhes pa nas/ sa chen gyi gzhung du 'byung bas de bzhin bya zhes pa'i bar/

gnyis pa gcad don dmigs par dril nas nyams su len pa la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni ma rgyud spyi dang 'dra bas/ de la lha bsgom pa/ sngags bzla ba/ bshags sdom bya ba dang gsum zhes sogs/ bde kye'i bskyed rim rnam bshad sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin bshad la/ gsung sgros yin gsung bar/ slar yang thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir da dung lan gcig bskyar na/ do nub nas brtsams te khyed rang rnams rang rang gi gnas mal rnams su bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas bzhugs/ dbugs rlung dang dngangs rngub pa rang zhir ma song gi bar la cung zad tsam ngal gsos/ de nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas nyams len gyi rim pa la 'jug par bya ste/ de la bzhi pa tshad med kyi rnal 'byor zhes sogs/ gsung sgros yin gsungs bar/ slar yang thugs zhes sogs tshar gcig bskyar la mjug sdud tshul gong bzhin la/ spyir btang ltar na rdor sems bsgom bzlas kyi rjes su bsngo smon yin no/ ༈ /nub gsum par dang po'i de yam tsam gcig bshad/ gnyis pa'i de tshang ma tshar gcig bshad nas/ da do nub kyi zhes sogs nas/ gnyis yod pa las bar/ lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni zhes pa nas ye shes tshogs bsags 'dis lam du byed pa'o gsungs bar/ gnyis pa bcad don dmigs par bsgril nas nyams su len pa la/ bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal gyi rnal 'byor ni nas/ gnas tshad bzhag go bar/ zhal shes gsum la yi ge zur na yod pa bzhin las zhal shes dang po gnyis bshad/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ba de thun gcig las bsgoms mi dgos/ slar yang sogs gong bzhin la/ da ci'i de lan gnyis bskyar/ mjug bsdu tshul yang rigs 'gre tshul sbyar nas dmigs bsal bsgyur bas 'thus/ de bzhin du 'og ma thams cad la 'dra ste/ dmigs pa sngon rim rnams rkang grangs yam me ba re bshad/ kha sang bshad pa de tshang 'grigs re bshad pa'i rjes su/

do nub kyi de sbrel ba dang / bshad ma thag pa de lan gnyis bshad pas gsum/ sang tshar gcig bshad pa de la bzhi bshad ces tshar lugs kyi phyag len la mdzad/ ngor pa rnams gsung ngag sogs 'chad pa'i skabs su de ring gnyis dang / sang gcig gsungs nas gsum bshad mdzad/ rdzong gong gnyis ni bshad pa'i spros pa ci yang mi mdzad par/ khrid yig dmar bsdus de thun bcad nas ngag slob tu mdzad nas sgom du bcug go /zhes pa'i 'phros don no/ ༈ /nub bzhi par gnyis yod pa las bar gong bzhin la/ dang po la drug pa lhar bskyed pa ni zhes pa nas/ rtog pa las 'char zhes bya ba yin la bar/ gnyis pa bcad don dmigs par bsgril nas nyams su len pa ni gnas tshad bzhag pa'i ngang las/ rang sems a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baṃ yig dmar po'i mthar zhes sogs mngon rtogs rgyun khyer zhar byung rdzogs rim dang bcas pa bshad nas rtsa sngags oṃ gsum ma dam bca' bzhin chags med du bzlas pas/ re zhig nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su rjes su 'dzin par bshad pa ni gang zag rab bzlas bsgom la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa zhes bya ba zhig yin pas khyed rang rnams kyang bsgom bzlas chag med nyams su len pa ni shin tu gal che ba yin bcas don dngos byed pa can gyi bskyed rim la/ sems 'dzin gyi rim pa rnams 'byung bas/ de la nga rgyal la sems 'dzin pa/ rnam pa spyi la sems 'dzin pa/ bye brag la sems 'dzin pa/ lus dkyil la sems 'dzin pa dang bzhi yod pa las/ dang po nga rgyal la sems 'dzin pa ni/ zhar byung rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i rjes su nga tha mal pa nam yang ma yin/ skyon kun zad yon tan kun rdzogs 'bras dus bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la bzhugs pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de dngos yin snyam du nga rgyal bskyed la hril gyis bsgrim tha mal gyi snang ba 'gags pa tsam byung na/

a 'thas mi bya bar mdun gyi dngos po gang rung zhig gi steng du sems spos la lhod kyis bzhag yang 'og 'gyu skyes na nga rgyal la hril gyis bsgrim/ de ltar byas kyang rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal mi 'char bar tha mal gyi rtog pa kho na shar kyang u tshugs mi bya bar rim gyis bslabs te de ltar thun chung la grangs mang ba'i tshul gyis nyams su blang ba'i mthar thun mong ba'i bsam mi khyab sogs sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin rjes kyi bya ba rnams bya dgos pa/ slar yang thugs sogs gong rnams bzhin no/ ༈ /nub lnga par sgro 'dogs gcod pa de yang ye shes tshogs gsog gi nas 'od phung du bsgom pa'o bar/ gcad don nyams len la/ de ltar nga rgyal sems bzung tshar ba'i rjes su/ gnyis pa rnam pa la sems 'dzin pa ni/ 'o na nga rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos yin na/ de'i rnam pa ji lta bu zhe na/ de'ang sku mdog nas/ spyi la sems 'dzin par byed/ hril gyis sgrim/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog skyes na gzhan la spo ba sogs gong bzhin byas la/ gsal na gsal te 'phro bcad/ mi gsal na mi gsal te 'phro bcad/ bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung zhing bsgom pa gong 'og kun tu gces so/ /mjug sdud tshul sogs gong bzhin no/ ༈ /drug pa sgro 'dogs gcod pa bzhi bsgyur ba ni nas/ bkal ba'i tshul gyis bsnams pa bor/ gcad don rnam pa spyi la sems bzung tshar nas/ de nas gsum pa bye brag la sems 'dzin pa ni spyan dbus ma nas langs pa lta bu la sems 'dzin par byed bar/ ༈ /bdun par sgro 'dogs gcod pa kun tu 'dzin pa'i nas/ rnam pa can bar/ gcad don de nas rim bzhin spyan nas dmar zhing legs pa bar/ ༈ /brgyad par sgro 'dogs gcod pa spyi bor rigs kyi nas/ byin rlabs byed pa yin bar/ gcad don mgul pa nas/ khreng zhing rgyas pa bar/ ༈ /dgu pa sgro 'dogs gcad pa bdun pa 'gro ba dag pa'i/ spro na kyai rdor bzhin bya bar/

gcad don phyag g.yas nas/ gsol ba bar/ ༈ /bcu par sgro 'dogs bcad pa de nas lag pa nas/ gnyis rnams su bsgom pa'o bar/ gcad don sked pa nas/ rgyan med pa la sems 'dzin par byed bar/ pho nya gsum bsre 'dis skabs su slob ma snod ldan la lus dkyil ston par 'dod na/ yig chung bzhin zur du gsum las mang ba la mi ston no/ ༈ /bcu gcig par sgro 'dogs gcad pa zhar byung 'bad par bya'o gsung bar/ gcad don de nas dpral ba nas/ mgul bar mgul rgyan bar/ ༈ /bcu gnyis par sgro 'dogs gcad pa zhar byung rdzogs rim ni nas/ 'jog par byed bar/ gcad don dpung pa gnyis nas/ nyams su len par byed pa bar/ ༈ /bcu gsum par sgro 'dogs gcad pa bcu pa bsam mi khyab nas/ byed pa yin gsungs bar/ gcad don lus dkyil bshad tshar ba rnams la lus dkyil gyi gtso mo'i spyan dbus mar sems 'dzin/ ༈ /bcu bzhi par sgro 'dogs gcad pa bcu gcig par spyod lam nas/ ma yengs par bya gsung bar/ gcad don lus dkyil gyi gtso mo'i spyan gnyis dang zhal la sems 'dzin/ ༈ /bco lnga par sgro 'dogs gcod pa gnyis pa yan lag nas/ nyams su len par byed bar/ gcad don gtso mo'i mgul nas zhabs kyi bar la sems 'dzin/ ༈ /bcu drug par sgro 'dogs gcad pa bzhi pa tshes bcu nas/ rang gnas su gshegs par bya'o bar/ gcad don gtso mo'i rgyan cha lugs la sems 'dzin/ ༈ /bcu bdun par sgro 'dogs gcad pa bzhi pa gang zag nas/ dbang po rab tu gyur pa'o bar/ gcad don lus dkyil 'khor gyi lha so drug gi spyan dbus mar sems 'dzin/ ༈ /bco brgyad par sgro 'dogs gcad pa gal te de ltar ma gyur kyang nas/ byed pa yin gsung bar/ gcad don 'khor so drug gi spyan gnyis nas zhabs kyi bar la sems 'dzin/ ༈ /bcu dgu par sgro 'dogs gcad pa gal te de ltar nas/ gal che gsungs so bar/ 'dir 'pho dmigs dngos gzhi mi ston par snod ldan re gnyis la 'ja' lus sgrub pa'i mjug tu yab yum gang rung gi 'pho dmigs mdzad nas gcig skabs su gang babs la gnang /

gcad don 'khor so drug rgyan can la sems 'dzin/ ༈ /nyi shu pa nas bzung rdzogs rim tshugs pas/ nyi shu par gnyis pa rdzogs rim ni nas rnal 'byor re bar/ slar yang sogs nas/ 'jug par byed ste bar gong bzhin la/ bskyed rim sems 'dzin dang bcas pa bsgom la rdzogs rim zab mo 'di nyid nyams su blangs te/ de yang chags chen pho nya lam nas/ rnal 'byor re bar slar yang sogs so/ ༈ /nyer gcig par gnyis pa rlung nas/ sel bar 'gyur gsung bar/ ༈ /nyer gnyis par gnyis pa ni yang smin mtshams nas/ 'char ba zhig 'ong la bar/ ༈ /nyer gsum par gong du bshad pa bzhin snod ldan la 'pho dmigs/ ༈ /nyer bzhi par zhal shes gsum pa thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas gsum las mang ba mi ston zhing / de'ang re re nas ston/ ༈ /nub nyer lnga par de nas thog mar nas tshul bzhin du bya'o gsung bar lan gsum bskyar ba'i rjes su/ de rnams kyi sgo nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam gyi rim pa zab mo cha tshang du thob pa yin pas bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu zhes dang / maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma phul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal du ma zad lus longs spyod sogs spyi 'gre bzhin deng nas sogs de rnams kyi sgo nas rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i nying khu grub pa mchog gi slob dpon dpal nā ro ta pa la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su gnang nas bzung / snyan nas snyan du zhal nas zhal du brgyud pa'i man ngag mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs can/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i zab chos snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gang zag dbang po rab 'bring tha ma shin tu tha ma dang bcas pa mkha' spyod du bgrod pa'i nye lam/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gcig rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i khrid bka' zab mo legs par thob pa yin pas nyams su len pa dang /

snod min la babs chol du mi ston zhing / snod ldan la bla ma'i phyag len bzhin rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du ston pa sogs rang gzhan gyi don mtha' yas pa mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs chos bsngo gang shes bya'o/ /de yang bla ma gong ma phar cher gyi phyag len la chos bsngor/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs dang / bshad nyan gyi bsngo ba mdo nas gsungs pa chos 'byung rnams su 'byung ba'i/ theg mchog dam chos rin chen nas mdzod du gyur bar mdzad/ de la'ang slob dpon gyis bshad 'di las zhes dang / slob mas nyan 'di las zhes tshig bsgyur dgos so/ /de ltar 'khrid 'chad tshul 'di ni rje mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i khrid yig chen mo dang / kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa'i mthong grol lde mig sor bzhag yin la/ thun mong ba dang bsdus pa la dga' na zhal shes gsum dang lus dkyil rdzogs rim rgyas pa 'pho ba rnams bzhag nas rnal 'byor bcu gcig zhar byung rdzogs rim dang bcas pas chog 'bring du byed na zhal shes gsum lus dkyil 'pho ba rnams bzhag nas bskyed rdzogs gnyis bstan pas chog shin tu rgyas par byed na gong du bshad pa ltar sngon 'gro chos 'byung / dngos gzhir 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs sogs kyis mdzad pa'i bskyed rim rnam bshad rgyas pa sbyar/ mkhyen brtse'i khrid yig dang mthong grol lde mig bzhin rdzogs nas chos nyid dngos ston gyi byin rlabs sngon 'gro'i dbu ma'i 'khrid rgyas pa yar lung pa dang / mkhyen brtse'i khrid yig bzhin bstan pas sgro 'dogs chod cing phyag len shin tu rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /sa skya pa'i phyag len thams cad mthun par 'khrid ma thob kyi bar la bskyed rim rnam bshad dang 'khrid pa'i lung mdzad srol med cing / slob ma rnams nas kyang lkog tu blta mi nyan la/ gal te bltas na dam nyams gsang ba'i dgra bo byin rlabs mi 'jug pa yin zhes gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang nas yang yang gsungs pa zhig yod pas gnad 'di'ang snying dkyil du 'chang zhing /

ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig dngos grub myur 'gugs la'ang phan thogs pa yod do/ /zhes rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'khrid 'chad tshul gyi zin bris 'di yang drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang dang / brag rtsa grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po gnyis kyi sku drin las lugs 'di'i skor la skal ba bzang por skyes pa sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gdan sa chen po'i zur 'chad rin chen rgyal mtshan sogs chos brgyud 'dzin pa rnams dang / rigs kyi bu sogs slad nas 'byon 'gyur gdung rabs rnams la phan pa'i bsam pas kha'u brag rdzong nag po'i me 'bar gtsug lag khang gi yang steng bla chen chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che sogs gong ma du mas grub gnyis mngon du mdzad pa'i gnas 'phags pa phug tu sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bkra shis rgyal mtshan no// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ sa skya pa'i zab chos nā ro mkha' spyod kyi khrid 'chad tshul sa chen thugs thig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
